prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: a bowl of day-old rice, cheese cubes, one tomato — one second still. Then motion: rice seasoned and pressed flat in a palm, a cheese cube tucked inside and the ball rolled closed, then into hot oil — violent sizzle, surfaces bronzing. Money shot: one golden ball broken open in extreme macro — melted cheese stretching between the halves in a long backlit pull, steam escaping. Final beat: the batch piled beside a quick blistered-tomato dipping sauce, one ball dunked. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the oil eruption, then the cheese pull. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido, o último da temporada: bolinho crocante de arroz de ontem com coração de queijo derretido. Dezembro vem aí — e essa série volta com a geladeira das festas. 🎄 **Quer a temporada de dezembro? Comenta EU QUERO 👇**
